description: This file contains utility functions for estimating compute time, memory usage, and data transfer time for tensor operations in PyTorch, specifically related to runtime estimation and performance profiling.

methods.name: get_compute_time
methods.description: Estimates the compute time in nanoseconds for a given tensor operation based on flop counts and GPU peak performance.

methods.name: get_num_bytes
methods.description: Calculates the memory size in bytes of a tensor, considering its shape, stride, and element size.

methods.name: get_transfer_time
methods.description: Estimates the data transfer time in nanoseconds for input and output tensors based on their sizes and GPU bandwidth.
